project: RLQAS Phase 4: Internal Research Tool — Unified Package, Python API, CLI, and Example Scripts
description: Phase 4 unifies Phase 1-3 into a single installable package 'rlqas' and adds a convenience layer on top. One 'pip install -e .' installs everything. Users write 'import rlqas; rlqas.search(...)' without knowing which phase provides what. No new quantum algorithms are implemented.

phaseDependencies.phase1: RLQAS Phase 1 (Phase1/006) — UCCSearchController, process_molecule, TencirchemCISimulator, PPOAgent
phaseDependencies.phase2: RLQAS Phase 2 (Phase2/full) — HEASearchController, AgentFactory, ExperimentManager, SequentialRLTester
phaseDependencies.phase3: RLQAS Phase 3 (Phase3/full) — HybridSearchController, BatchEvaluator, EncoderFactory, QubitUCCSearchController
phaseDependencies.prerequisite: All three phases must already exist on disk at ../../Phase1/006, ../../Phase2/full, ../../Phase3/full

overallGoal: Single 'pip install -e .' command installs all four phases. Users import via top-level 'import rlqas' namespace. Deliver: (1) unified setup.py with Phase 1-3 as file:// dependencies, (2) top-level rlqas.search() / rlqas.Experiment API, (3) rlqas CLI, (4) runnable example scripts.

tasks.title: Unified Package Setup + Top-level Python API (RLQAS_Phase4_001)
tasks.description: Create setup.py that lists Phase 1-3 as local file:// dependencies so one pip install covers everything. Then implement src/rlqas/__init__.py (top-level namespace) and src/rlqas/api.py (search + Experiment). The rlqas namespace must coexist with existing rlqas.phase1 / rlqas.phase2 / rlqas.phase3 sub-packages via Python implicit namespace packages.
acceptance_criteria: setup.py exists with name='rlqas', version='4.0.0', and install_requires listing rlqas-phase1, rlqas-phase2, rlqas-phase3 as local file:// paths
After 'pip install -e .', all four phases are importable in a single Python session: rlqas, rlqas.phase1, rlqas.phase2, rlqas.phase3
src/rlqas/__init__.py exports search and Experiment at the top level

rlqas.search('H2', 0.74, ansatz_type='UCC', agent_type='ppo', n_episodes=50) returns dict with keys: best_energy, fci_energy, energy_error_mha, chemical_accuracy, n_operators, fusion_template, molecule, ansatz_type, agent_type, n_episodes_run
rlqas.search dispatches correctly: 'UCC'+PPO -> UCCSearchController, others -> HybridSearchController
rlqas.Experiment(molecule_config, search_config, rl_config).run() returns the same result dict
rlqas.Experiment.save(path) / .load(path) round-trip works correctly
rlqas.search with invalid ansatz_type raises ValueError listing valid options
ANTI-HOLLOW: rlqas.search('H2', 0.74, 'UCC', n_episodes=50) returns energy_error_mha > 0 and < 50
Smoke test in tests/smoke/test_api_smoke.py passes on H2 (50 episodes)

tasks.title: CLI Entry Point (RLQAS_Phase4_002)
tasks.description: Implement src/rlqas/cli.py using argparse with two subcommands: 'rlqas search' (inline args) and 'rlqas experiment' (YAML config). Registered as console_scripts entry point. Both subcommands delegate to rlqas.search() — no duplicated logic.
acceptance_criteria: 'rlqas search --molecule H2 --bond-length 0.74 --ansatz UCC --agent ppo --episodes 50' exits 0 and prints result table
'rlqas experiment --config <yaml_path>' runs and prints result table
'rlqas search --help' and 'rlqas experiment --help' print usage
'rlqas search --ansatz INVALID' exits 1 with a clear error message
--output <path> flag saves result JSON when provided
setup.py entry_points console_scripts registers 'rlqas=rlqas.cli:main'
Smoke test: subprocess.run(['rlqas', 'search', '--molecule', 'H2', ...], check=True) succeeds

tasks.title: Example Scripts (RLQAS_Phase4_003)
tasks.description: Four standalone example scripts in examples/. Each is self-contained, runnable as 'python examples/<script>.py', and uses the top-level rlqas API. These are the primary reference for future use of this codebase.
acceptance_criteria: examples/01_ucc_search_lih.py: LiH (2,5) 10q, PPO 200 episodes, asserts chemical accuracy
examples/02_hea_search_beh2.py: BeH2 (4,4) 8q, DQN 200 episodes, prints result
examples/03_hybrid_search_beh2.py: BeH2 (4,4) 8q, PPO 200 episodes, prints fusion_template
examples/04_multi_algorithm_comparison.py: PPO/DQN/A2C on LiH (2,5) 100 episodes each, prints comparison table
All four run without error via subprocess in tests/smoke/test_examples_smoke.py
Each script has a header comment: molecule, ansatz, agent, expected output
